role: recipe v1 single arm vs the published G0+ reference (all four changes together; no single-item attribution allowed)

1_deep_group_decoder.module: GroupQueryHead.deep = DeepGroupDecoder(4 layers, width 1024, 8 heads, MLP hidden 2048, GELU, dropout 0)
1_deep_group_decoder.order: LN(q)->query self-attn->residual; LN(q)->cross-attn(token features incl. spatial encoding)->residual; LN(q)->Linear(1024,2048)->GELU->Linear(2048,1024)->residual; final LayerNorm
1_deep_group_decoder.replaces: the single cross-attention + MLP query path in the recipe forward only; old parameters stay registered for strict loading of old checkpoints

semantic.note: unchanged; the two coefficients were split

3_fixed_void.slot_101_logit: fixed 0 (softmax over 101 columns), learnable shared background_bias not used in the recipe forward
3_fixed_void.old_bias: kept in the model and optimizer groups for checkpoint compatibility, expected gradient None

4_token_assignment_ce.targets: context frames only, from the verified routing_v2 per-token contribution statistics (alpha>0.5, valid annotation; thing -> its matched query column via the current Hungarian pairing, stuff -> column 101; 255/invalid/no-id/unmatched instances ignored)
4_token_assignment_ce.form: seg_ramp * assign_coef * CE_balanced (0.5*mean thing tokens + 0.5*mean rest-only tokens)
4_token_assignment_ce.assign_coef_rule: median of four no-update gradient ratios (aux/main) = 0.0250 < 0.05 -> 0.2 (else 0.02)
4_token_assignment_ce.assign_every_rule: timing smoke median ratio with/without target computation = 1.2677 <= 1.5 -> recompute every step

unchanged.data: processed ScanNet, 32 train / 8 unseen, 2 context + 2 novel
unchanged.optimizer: AdamW betas (0.9,0.95), grad clip 1.0, lr 1e-4, warmup 2000, cosine to 2% over 6000
unchanged.optimizer_groups: existing two groups preserved and extended: new 2-D weights -> wd 0.05 group, new 1-D/bias -> no-decay group (same lr)

preflight.smoke_measurement_note: the literal smoke criterion is measured with both ramps frozen at the step-1 value, because at steps 1..20 the pre-registered ramps are still rising and a step-0 (ramp=0) reference cannot be matched; both numbers are recorded in the preflight manifest
